title: Relative Fat Mass
description: This schema represents a person's relative fat mass (RFM).

references.description: Relative fat mass (RFM) as a new estimator of whole-body fat percentage

effective_time_frame.description: The date-time at which, or time interval during which the measurement is asserted as being valid.
